method: Evaluated detailed meshes with Blender drivers; exact mesh Z extrema for support planes; BVH triangle intersection for exterior assembly pairs.
intended_fit_exclusions: Fasteners inside their own tapped seats; spindle/bearing insertion; nested covered slide bearings.
Feet/base against bench are intended support interfaces.
Objective/specimen contact is a functional unsafe-focus domain; no removal of those contacts or reduction of focus limits.

grip_contact_coverage.method: All evaluated vertices against the union of the same-link authored contact cylinders; maximum signed radial/axial excess.

functional_contact_envelope.scope: Indexed objective stations and centered XY specimen only. Signed vertical extrema plus exact triangle intersection; negative gap is an unsafe commanded pose, not evidence that native dynamics permits passage.
